notes.title: Bounty Battle Release Date Update
notes.notes:
After a short hiatus we're happy to confirm that Bounty Battle is still coming later this year.

[previewyoutube=vdOQHQRRHIU;full][/previewyoutube]

The All-Star Indie Fighter will land on console and PC on September 10th.

You can read all about the recent announcement here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33417793/00b326be6e5cd99c48050a088ff02bcf77460adc.png

We hope you've added Bounty battle to your wishlist because it's going to be a doozy!
